articles.title: Hackers Impersonate Major Defense Companies to Spread GravityRAT Spyware and Steal Sensitive Data
articles.summary:
Hackers are using the logos of major defense and aerospace companies on a fake recruitment website to spread GravityRAT spyware. The site promises connections to overseas employers and offers an Android résumé builder that can steal text messages, location data, and files. Lockheed Martin, Airbus, and BAE Systems are among the brands displayed as supposed […]

articles.title: Japan Shuts Down Fugaku Supercomputer After Hackers Breach Internal Servers
articles.summary:
Japan’s RIKEN research institute suspended operations of its Fugaku supercomputer on November 14, 2026, after an intruder breached the system’s internal operations network and installed malicious software on some servers. The breach may have exposed account information for up to 4,597 users across Fugaku and RIKYU. RIKEN also confirmed that the intruder used some stolen […]

articles.title: Hackers Use Stolen FortiGate VPN Credentials to Access Corporate Networks and Deploy Custom Malware
articles.summary:
A threat actor known as “tcherber” is selling and using stolen FortiGate VPN logins to get into company networks. The same person also builds custom malware, including a stealer, a remote desktop tool, and ransomware. The campaign shows how one weak VPN password can open the way to data theft and file encryption. The actor […]

articles.title: Hackers Hijack AI Coding Agents Through Malicious GitHub Repositories to Steal Developer Credentials
articles.summary:

articles.title: Google Reveals How Russian Hackers Used One Cloud Breach to Compromise Another US Organization
articles.summary:
Russian state-sponsored hackers broke into a U.S. organization’s Google Workspace environment in late 2025, stole its staff directory and cloud files, and used information from the breach to target a second U.S. organization in 2026. articles.title: Critical Apache HTTP Server RCE Vulnerability Actively Exploited in Attacks
articles.summary:
Apache’s HTTP/2 module, mod_http2, has a critical flaw tracked as CVE-2026-119618 that reportedly allows unauthenticated remote code execution. Apache released version 2.4.71 on November 11 to fix the flaw, which it rates as critical, while Singapore’s CSA assigns it a high-severity CVSS 3.1 score of 8.1/10. Singapore’s CSA warned of active exploitation on November 17, […]
